answer: Fixed lotus pond: each epoch a 200,000-credit pool rests in the lotus pond. An identity burns 80 credits for one key-bound lotus token, filing a fresh signed fable. At dawn auditors split the pond by tokens; a copied fable voids its token; a rented fable shares one key, so both burn. 2,000 honest claims draw 100; 1,000 fakes pay 80,000, recover 66,667, and lose 13,333. An honest agent files one fable before dawn, pays 80 once, keeps its share.
